question:
Batch 43 = V1 SECOND VISION BACK-END, the route (law L-x: every model role has at least two interchangeable back-ends, the local model on Ultron first where it meets the quality bar; law L-r: anything loaded on GPU0 goes through the GPU0 lease and gpu0.swap_to). V1 asks vision models a checklist about contact sheets / frames and fails closed on any 'no' or missing answer. New: visual_check._call_any(path, text, model, timeout) routes a model named 'ollama:<name>' to _call_local (gpu0.swap_to(model) first, which raises a Gpu0Stop (a BaseException) when the caller does not hold the GPU0 lease; then Ollama /api/chat with the image, temperature 0) and any other name to the unchanged Heimdall request; ask_vision, ask_letterbox and ask_boundary call it. The default panel VISION_MODELS is unchanged; LOCAL_VISION is on no panel yet (its quality is measured first on the labelled V1 cases).
FIND: any way the Heimdall path changed; a local call that can load on GPU0 without the lease or swallow a GPU0 stop as an ordinary route error; a malformed local reply read as a pass (the callers' parsers must still fail closed); tests that do not test what they claim. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

consensus_findings.issue: The lease test's skipIf(gpu0.held()) means that on a GPU session the entire TestLocalRouteNeedsTheLease class is skipped, so the 'no lease → Gpu0Stop' claim is untested there; also the test never asserts that no Ollama request was made (the 'no_load_no_request' name promises it) — _call_local is not patched, so a real HTTP call could happen if the lease were somehow held, and nothing checks the request count.
consensus_findings.evidence: @unittest.skipIf(gpu0.held(), "a GPU session holds the lease: the refusal is tested in a CPU session") ... def test_no_lease_no_load_no_request(self): ... with self.assertRaises(gpu0.Gpu0Stop): VC._call_local(img, "q", VC.LOCAL_VISION, 5)
consensus_findings.fix: Assert the Ollama endpoint is never contacted (e.g. patch urllib.request.urlopen with a counter) inside the no-lease test, and/or run the refusal assertions in a session where gpu0.held() is guaranteed False.

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: gpu0.swap_to(model) is called with the full 'ollama:gemma3:27b' string; if gpu0.swap_to expects a bare model name (or passes it through to the Ollama/registry loader), the lease-protected load may target the wrong model name — the 'ollama:' prefix is stripped for the HTTP body (model.split(':',1)[1]) but NOT for swap_to, so the swapped/loaded model and the requested model can diverge.
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.fix: Strip the prefix before swapping: gpu0.swap_to(model.split(':', 1)[1]) (or confirm gpu0.swap_to accepts the 'ollama:'-prefixed name and document it).

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: The image file handle from open(image_path, 'rb') is never closed (no with/finally); under repeated V1 runs this leaks file descriptors until GC, and on some platforms an open handle can interfere with later cleanup of the work dir.
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.fix: with open(image_path, 'rb') as f: img_b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode() then use img_b64 in the body.

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: The second assertRaises wraps VC.ask_vision(..., attempts=1) but the test only proves the Gpu0Stop propagates out of ask_vision; it does not verify the documented 'a run turns it into a HOLD naming the cause' behavior — ask_vision's except-Exception clause catches only Exception, and Gpu0Stop being a BaseException means it escapes the retry loop, so the HOLD-with-cause path (tries list, answers={}) is never exercised; the docstring/audit claim 'a Gpu0Stop that a run turns into a HOLD naming the cause' is not what the code does.
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.evidence: except Exception as e:  # in ask_vision — Gpu0Stop is a BaseException, not Exception, so it is NOT caught/retried/HOLDed
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.fix: Either catch BaseException (or (Exception, gpu0.Gpu0Stop)) in ask_vision/ask_letterbox/ask_boundary so a lease refusal becomes answers={} + a named cause in tries, or change the test/docstring to assert propagation instead of HOLD.
